{{Top|leg}}
'''Rootjiggers''' were [[Insect/Legends|insects]] that lived in the plains of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Hidden amidst the [[nola grass]], they made a noise [[Human/Legends|Humans]] could not stand, but which attracted rootjiggers' mates.<ref name="The Monster">{{GamerCite|2|The Monster}}''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The habits of rootjiggers are inspired by the habits of [[Wikipedia:Cricket (insect)|crickets]].
